name: Kaimon Fishmongers
description: Kaimon Fishmongers is a calm, block-based WordPress theme built for independent fishmongers, coastal markets, and food shops. Designed with an editorial aesthetic of film-grain imagery, speckled ground tones, and ruled landing tables, it showcases daily harbour catches, cut-to-order services, and counter schedules. Fully responsive and WooCommerce-compatible, it offers structured patterns for boat rosters, price boards, and kitchen trim stories.
